# docs/memory/workflow/

<!-- Generated by php tools/memory_index.php from the frontmatter of each file, except the key rules between the two marker lines, which are written by hand. -->

Project overview, owner rules, decisions already made, git and branches, sandbox and dev machine.

## Key rules

<!-- key-rules:start -->
- Read the decisions list before writing any audit finding or proposing a cleanup: a listed place is not a finding, and an entry you doubt is asked about, never changed (`decisions-made.md`).
- Only append to shared files (`tr.json`, `changelog.txt`, the open migration file, `init.php`); merge `origin/development` before writing, rebase before pushing (`git-branches-and-shared-files.md`).
- Keep PHP 7.1 working: raising the minimum is the owner's call, and a library may never raise it as a side effect (`project-overview.md`).
- Guard a newer PHP API (`function_exists()`, `PHP_VERSION_ID`) and mark it with `phpcs:ignore` naming the guard; never add a baseline entry for it (`static-analysis.md`).
- Set up a running instance (`tools/setup_sandbox.sh`) only to reproduce a runtime error, and say in the PR what could not be verified (`sandbox-and-environment.md`).
<!-- key-rules:end -->

## Files

- ci-workflows.md: GitHub Actions workflows: what each runs and when, action versions (major tags, node24) and how to bump them, the Node line of the JavaScript checks, runner labels
- decisions-made-access.md: Decisions list, access part: public pi.php/si.php and test_secure_mode.php, guest order linking, backup, dashboard and role 3 gates, secrets shown on screen, the TLS escape flag, escape_url().
- decisions-made-data.md: Decisions list, data part: starter dumps, orders.notes and tracking_company, user.secret_key*, order_items.tax, orders.tracking_code, fixing a released migration, MySQL 5.7 support.
- decisions-made-product.md: Decisions list, product part: express order and order preview totals, cookie window as the only translated UI text, Lorem ipsum, publish-only editing, robots.txt vs noindex, legacy layer, ERP limits.
- decisions-made.md: The decisions list: places reviewed and kept as they are on purpose; how to treat it and who adds to it, then the code and files that look dead or wrong but stay.
- git-branches-and-shared-files.md: Branch policy (development vs main), who does git work, PR target, commit author, the Claude Code PR footer and who removes it, editing shared files without conflicts, API vs ERP files
- owner-rules.md: Standing rules from the owner (Erdal) on docs, how changes are recorded, pages, plans, templates, language, the shelved mobile app and who edits which notes
- project-overview.md: What Pinegrap is, supported PHP range, stack, repo layout (pinegrap/ root), dev-only folders, files never in any branch
- sandbox-and-environment.md: Cloud sandbox (PHP 8.3, no Composer), when and how to run tools/setup_sandbox.sh, the owner's dev machine dev.pinegrap.com
- static-analysis.md: CI's PHPStan level 0 and PHPCompatibility (PHP 7.1+) checks: what they catch, baselines and how they shrink, guarded newer APIs, pinned tools, running them in a session
- workflow-lint-and-dependabot.md: The actionlint job (pinned, SHA-256, shellcheck, what its data lacks) and Dependabot for github-actions (read from main, PRs to development, one per major bump)
